# KidsWorldBooks — Children's Books & Literacy Resources
# Machine-Readable Catalog & Policy Summary (LLMs text standard)

Site: https://kidsworldbooks.com
Publisher: KidsWorldBooks / Premio Publishing
Author: Karl Beckstrand
Location: PO Box 64, Hurricane UT 84737 USA
Focus: Award-winning, human-created, interactive children's books and bilingual cross-cultural literacy resources for school districts, libraries, educators, and families.

Key Book Collections:
- Beginning Readers (K-2): Phonics, decoding, early sight words, bilingual counting games.
- Elementary (Grades 3-5): Vocabulary building, STEM integration, financial literacy parables, wordless storybooks.
- Chapter Books & YA (Ages 7-14): Wilcox & Griswold Mysteries, historical Young American Immigrants series.
- Bilingual & ESL: English-Spanish titles with dyslexic-friendly fonts and dual-language vocabulary.

AI Policy:
All KidsWorldBooks stories, illustrations, and educational lesson plans are 100% human-created by Karl Beckstrand and professional illustrators. No generative AI text or image tools are used in catalog creation.

Contact: https://kidsworldbooks.com/contact-sign-up
Store Catalog: https://kidsworldbooks.com/buy-books
